overview.description: The Tradr 2X Long CPNG Daily ETF (CPNX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in consumer discretionary equity. The fund provides 2x exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of Coupang, Inc. (CPNG) CPNX was launched on Apr 24, 2026 and is issued by Tradr.
